mapper.update: UPDATE med_exam_appointment SET `status` = 2, checkin_time = NOW() WHERE appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND `status` = 1 AND id_card_no = #{dto.idCardNo}
mapper.select: select patient_name as patientName, gender, phone, appointment_date as appointmentDate, status, timestampdiff(YEAR, birth_date, now()) as age from med_exam_appointment where order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT a.appointment_no as appointmentNo, o.snapshot_id AS snapshotId FROM med_exam_appointment a JOIN trade_order o ON a.order_id = o.order_id WHERE a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND a.id_card_no = #{dto.idCardNo}

SELECT a.appointment_no as appointmentNo, a.order_id AS orderId, o.snapshot_id AS snapshotId, a.patient_name as patientName, a.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,a.birth_date, NOW()) AS age, a.id_card_no as idCardNo, a.phone, a.appointment_date as appointmentDate, a.company FROM med_exam_appointment a JOIN trade_order o ON a.order_id = o.order_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
